description: Check that a project is ready for a sprint review: git history, the model and its API key, screenshots and brand files. Returns one line per check, each marked ok or with what to fix. Reads only; no model call. Use it first in a new project.

directory.description: The project folder: a git repository, with or without sprint-review.config.yml. Default: the folder the server started in.

name: check_sprint_review_setup
title: Check the setup
